name: 程程工作台 - S360 已批准批次消费者

steps.label: Claim
steps.prompt: Claim at most one approved batch with scripts/claim_security_batch.py. No batch is a silent no-op. Claim is not permission to execute.

steps.label: Live preflight
steps.prompt: Read the create-only envelope. Invoke only its allowlisted route-specific security skill. Re-read S360 digest, live Pod image/tag/commit, repository main SHA, Dockerfile FROM, Git tags and build state. Create an exact plan bound to the envelope SHA256. Any changed baseline requires reapproval and zero execution.

steps.label: Bounded execution
steps.prompt: Execute only the exact digest-bound plan represented by the approved envelope. Follow route-specific skill gates and staged eDog -> verify -> Prod where applicable. Never infer repository, image, tag, or environment.

steps.label: Verify and synchronize
steps.prompt: Collect PR/tag/build/deployment/Pod/S360 evidence and call record_security_batch_result.py. Verified requires S360 cleared. Drain the Workbench Teams outbox: send each claimed item to the user's Scout Teams Bot 1:1 chat, then acknowledge it. Never send the same event twice.
